--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,30 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
+    # Validate inputs
+    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
+    for arr, name in zip([logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call],
+                         ['logp_with_result', 'logp_call_only', 'logp_no_call']):
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2D")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Compute improvements (L_no_call - L_with_result, L_no_call - L_call_only)
+    # L = -sum(logp), so improvement = sum(logp_no_call) - sum(logp_alt)
+    improvement_with_result = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1) - np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    improvement_placeholder = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1) - np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    keep = (improvement_with_result > tau_filter) & (improvement_placeholder > tau_filter)
+    margins = np.minimum(improvement_with_result, improvement_placeholder)
+    return keep, margins
